notes.title: Build 0.967
notes.notes:
[b]Build 0.967[/b] - [u]Quest Update Part 2[/u] and [u]Season update Part 1[/u]

Hi everyone!
I've been quite busy as of late but finally pushed out this update!
this update includes the following;

[list]
[*] [u]Bug fixes for Quest Update Part 1[/u]
[*] [u]Fixed crash on enemy attack in second dungeon.[/u]
[*] [u]Fixed bug that would prevent day/night cycle from continuing.[/u]
[*] [u]Added different tilesets[/u] for [u]each stage of The Red Moon[/u]
[*] [u]Redesigned how fast/slow mining is[/u], as well as chances of getting ore.
[/list]

Of course as this update was started quite some time ago, then continued a lot later, there is quite a bit of things left unfinished. The Quest system will undergo a Update Part 3 to finish it off in the coming months as I had to redo a lot of things that went wrong.
With that being said, I did push part 1 of the seasons update out early, and with that i will focus on a visual overhaul after the quest system is fully integrated. 
[i][u][b]
So what's next?[/b][/u][/i]
[i][list]
[*] Quest Update Part 3.
[*] Season Update Part 2.
[*] More Bug Fixes.
[*] Re-Balancing of Weapons and Enemy Damage.
[*] Continuation of Visual Overhaul.
[*] Character Portrait art integration
[*] Redesign of Character sprites
[*] Integrating NSFW content/scenes 
[*] Enabling Endgame content
[*] Transition from Early Access to Full Release.
[/list][/i]

This list is in prioritized order,
The development cycle will be at least  1 update per month or 2 as I do have work taking up quite a lot of my time and this is a solo project.

Thanks you for your patience and supporting the game <3
-Kitten

notes.title: Upcoming Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 
[u]It's been quite some time![/u]
[u]The next update for the game should be out hopefully before the end of next week![/u] 
[b][u]These are the Patch notes for the Next Update[/u][/b]
So, what does it add?

[u][b]The Quest System[/b][/u]
Now main quests are a thing, pretty much making the main story run off of it, from dungeon to dungeon and so on. [i](Later after the quest update this will link to encounters with npcs and other dialogue to better explain the story and the fear of The Red Moon between villagers and so on.)[/i]
 
Other additions to the Quest System also are;
*Obtaining Main and Side Quests from the Inn Manager
*Turning in Quests to the Inn Manager
*Bountys on beasts haunting the town on certain nights
*Mining Quests (You can't access these until you progress further in the game)

[u][b]Besides the Quest System what about the reworking of all the graphic elements?[/b][/u]
Well this may not come to a surprise, as it takes a lot of time, i'm mainly working on it by myself with assistance of a best friend of mine from the occasion, so [i]the graphical rework is probably the most difficult bit.[/i] 
However [i][u]this will not delay development[/u][/i] of the story and mechanics/bug fixes, most likely after the Quest Update will come the UI update with some tilesets redone. i'd like to get all the tilesets redone, though that takes time and [i]I cannot rush it too much[/i] as i want things to blend properly. Some tiles already don't fully blend, though I'll get that fixed asap after this update!

Other things such as Bug fixes as well of course have been added. 
I've been working had these past few months to bring a bigger update, rather than just a small bug fix, as the game is nearing its end of early access within the next 4 months.

That's all for now and I do sincerely apologize for lack of updates.
Updates WILL NOT take as long from now on after the Quest System is fully integrated.

Thank you all for your patience,
Kitten

notes.title: Early Access Launched!
notes.notes:
Early Access is live now! 
The game is 5.99USD with a 20% launch discount. (Price may vary depending on country currency)
Now to answer some questions;

Will the game have trading cards, badges and backgrounds?
Yes, that is the plan later on during the early access period.

How long will it be before the artstyle gets its overhaul?
If I were to estimate, i'd say 1 to 2 months as that is the planned early access timeline if all goes as planned.

When will the game have it's "endgame"?
Although this is also an estimate, around 1 to 2 months as well as I still need to flesh out the beginning scenes and overhaul certain areas.


I hope to improve the game throughout the early access period and iron out all of those nasty bugs! 

To help do that, you can post on the corresponding steam discussion page to help!

That's all for now!
-Kitten

notes.title: Early Access Release Date Set!
notes.notes:
The game will launch on Steam Early Access on the 18th of July!

Now into how Early Access for this title will go;
There will be bug fix updates, and then major updates containing art assets and so forth to eventually lead to the whole gfx overhaul, but earlier will have the full implementation of Intimate Moments and other content alike.

The game will have a 20% discount on Early Access launch of course, and will have a price rise upon completion by 1 - 2 usd.

If you have any questions please post on the Discussions!

Thanks,
-Kitten
